entities.summary: Johannes (Hans) Pfundtner was a German lawyer and civil servant whose career spanned the German Empire, the Weimar Republic and Nazi Germany. During the Nazi era, he was the senior State Secretary in the Reich Interior Ministry and was involved in drafting the Nuremberg Laws. He committed suicide towards the end of the Second World War in Europe.
